recipe.title: LIFE SUPPORT  •  GREEN
recipe.body:

recipe.title: SUPPLY WARNINGS  •  AMBER
recipe.body:
LiOH: 4.5 days at current burn
Recycler filters: 2 spares
EVA O₂ canisters: 6 / 8 full
Food: 32 days
Resupply ETA: Sol 63 (+16 sols)

recipe.title: ESCALATION CRITERIA
recipe.body:
RED  O₂ <19.5%  •  CO₂ >0.8%  •  pressure <68 kPa
AMBER  Scrubber ΔP >+10% or power <72%
STOP EVA  Comms loss >90 seconds
CALL COMMAND  Any RED or two simultaneous AMBERs
SAFE MODE  No command acknowledgement within 3 minutes

recipe.title: TODAY'S MAINTENANCE SEQUENCE
recipe.body:
06:30  Isolate scrubber B
06:40  Inspect filter and ΔP sensor
07:05  Swap cartridge if ΔP exceeds +10%
07:25  Inspect Array 2 dust load
08:00  Verify relay and habitat comms
HOLD SCIENCE if life-support status changes

recipe.title: CREW ASSIGNMENTS
recipe.body:
Reyes  Command, comms, go / no-go
Okafor  Scrubber B and power
Chen  Medical and EVA standby
Patel  Brine assay and sample imaging
